description: This Python source file defines a Sphinx extension for managing external content inclusion. It includes functions to adjust include directives in reStructuredText files and synchronize external files into the documentation source directory, supporting incremental updates and configurable directives and file patterns.

methods.name: adjust_includes
methods.description: Adjusts include directives in reStructuredText files to correct paths based on the base path and directives.

methods.name: sync_contents
methods.description: Synchronizes external content files into the Sphinx source directory, copying new or updated files and removing obsolete ones, with support for configurable patterns and directives.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Sphinx extension by adding configuration values and connecting the synchronization function to the build process.
